stem: The same rare sex-expression anomaly appears in one genotype under high-stress runs but not in lower-stress replicated runs. What is the most defensible interpretation?
choices: The response may reflect genotype-by-environment interaction and should be evaluated with replicated stress and control observations
The genotype is proven universally unstable
The anomaly should be removed from records because it is rare
rationale: A conditional repeated response supports investigating genotype-by-environment interaction rather than a universal genetic or environmental conclusion.
